notes: nm IDENTITY TSM = Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, CIK 1046179, NYSE ADS; one ADS = 5 common shares (20-F, section on employee plans: 'each ADS represents five (5) common shares'); IBKR contract 6223250 (NYSE, USD); home listing TWSE 2330 (IBKR 37928709). Reporting currency TWD (NT$), quote currency USD, FYE Dec 31, files 20-F and 6-K (quarterly financials and releases are 6-K). Common shares outstanding 25,932,524,521 at 2025-12-31 (20-F cover) = about 5.19 billion ADS equivalents. EPS per ADS = 5 x EPS per share (20-F FY2025 diluted NT$327.34 per ADS).

nm CURRENCY every nm_ fact is TWD in full units (not millions) unless its unit says USD; USD-per-ADR figures are the company's own translations at each quarter's rate, which differ from the 20-F convenience rate (FY2025 20-F: US$10.43 diluted per ADS at 31.37 NT$/US$, versus US$10.65 from summing the four quarterly release figures).

nm ACCOUNTING BASIS releases and quarterly 6-K reports are TIFRS (Taiwan-endorsed IFRS); the 20-F states IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the IASB. All filings are IFRS, not US GAAP: SBC is tiny (NT$1.2bn in FY2025, 0.03% of revenue), so GAAP-vs-adjusted EPS does not diverge on SBC.

nm PRICE ADR last US$408.79 (IBKR snapshot, timestamp 2026-10-30 23:59 UTC, is_close false, so the Friday 2026-10-30 close or last print; 2026-11-01 is a Sunday). Month-end close Oct 2026 US$406.13. 5-year monthly history and dividends saved; no split in the window; ADR quarterly dividends US$0.94-1.10 (latest ex-date 2026-09-16, US$1.096).

nm AV NOT CALLED 2026-11-01: owner states the Alpha Vantage daily limit is already exhausted; INCOME_STATEMENT, BALANCE_SHEET, CASH_FLOW, EARNINGS_ESTIMATES not retried. FMP statements and analyst are ACCESS DENIED on this plan (session_capabilities), not called. Second source for statements is therefore the TWSE-style 6-K reports and releases (same issuer), not an independent provider: reconciliation is 20-F vs 6-K vs release.

nm RECONCILIATION FY2025 (20-F, NT$ million): revenue 3,809,054.3; gross profit 2,281,294.0 (59.9%); operating income 1,936,091.7; net income 1,695,124.9 total, 1,697,604.0 attributable to parent; CFO 2,274,975.6; PP&E purchases 1,272,410.5 (+ intangibles 10,146.9); SBC 1,246.1; depreciation 679,684.0 + amortization 8,412.4; diluted shares 25,930.6 million; diluted EPS NT$65.47. The prefetch pf_net_income_fy2024 (1,157,523.9) is TOTAL net income including non-controlling interests; parent net income FY2024 is 1,158,380.2 (difference 856.3 = NCI loss): nm_net_income_fy2025 uses the parent figure, so the two years are not on the same line (difference below 0.1%).

nm RECONCILIATION companyfacts (and so every pf_ fact) ends at FY2024: the FY2025 20-F has no XBRL companyfacts rows, and no 2026 quarter is in it. FY2025, Q4 2025 to Q3 2026 and H1 2026 facts are therefore entered here from the 20-F text, the releases and the Q2-2026 6-K report. The Q3-2026 consolidated report (6-K, usually mid-November) is not filed yet: Q3 operating income, CFO and capex are unknown; Q3 operating margin 58.7% is a release figure (derived operating income about NT$877bn, not entered).

nm RECONCILIATION latest quarter Q2 2026 (6-K, NT$ thousand): revenue 1,270,380,250; gross profit 860,310,695 (67.7%); operating income 766,602,651 (60.3%); net income to parent 706,561,938; diluted EPS 27.25; matches release (NT$1,270.38bn, NT$706.56bn, NT$27.25). H1 2026: revenue 2,404,483,690; operating income 1,425,568,793; CFO 1,482,341,242; PP&E purchases 846,764,746 (H1 2025: 628,052,531, +35%); SBC 237 (thousand); H1 diluted EPS 49.32. Diluted share count for 2026 not read (EPS-implied about 25.93 billion).

nm DIFFERENCE equity at 2025-12-31 differs by presentation: 20-F equity attributable to parent NT$5,355,038.7 million (total equity 5,396,219.2) versus the Q2-2026 6-K comparative column 5,419,595.994 million (total 5,460,795.3), i.e. 64.6bn higher; total assets agree within 0.2bn (7,932,842.5 vs 7,933,023.9). The 20-F has an extra appropriation to special capital reserve (87,284.5) and the 64.5bn gap matches a 20-F note figure of 64,502.7; cause not confirmed (looks like a dividend-declared or reserve presentation). The analyst should use the 20-F number for FY2025 and the 6-K number for the 2026 balance sheets, and not mix them in one ratio.

nm ONE-OFF Q2 2026 net income includes a NT$63.2bn pre-tax gain on disposal of investments accounted for using the equity method (nm_oneoff_gain_q2_2026; H1 other gains and losses NT$59.9bn net; the 6-K of 2026-05-15 'TSMC to sell 81% of Vanguard International' is the likely event, not read). That is about 9% of Q2 net income; about NT$2.4 per share before tax (tax effect not read), about US$0.38 per ADR. Q3 net income (763.06bn, +8.0% q/q) is therefore stronger than the headline q/q growth against a one-off-inflated Q2; Q2 operating income (60.3% margin) is clean of it because the gain is below operating income.

nm TRAILING EARNINGS last four reported quarters Q4 2025 to Q3 2026: EPS NT$19.50+22.08+27.25+29.43 = NT$98.26 per share (NT$491.3 per ADS); in US$ per ADR as released 3.14+3.49+4.31+4.60 = US$15.54; ex the Q2 one-off about US$15.2. Q3 2026 x 4 = NT$117.7 per share (US$18.4 per ADR) is a run rate with peak-cycle margins, not a base.

nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY trailing P/E on the ADR, calendar year-end close over GAAP-IFRS diluted EPS per ADS (5 x pf/20-F EPS translated to US$; FX rates for 2021-2024 are approximate averages from memory, not sourced: 27.9, 29.8, 31.2, 32.1; 2025 uses the 20-F rate 31.37): 2021 29.4, 2022 11.6, 2023 19.8, 2024 28.4, 2025 29.1, now 26.3 (US$408.79 over US$15.54 trailing four quarters). low 11.6 median 27.4 high 29.4 now 26.3 years 2021-2026. Year-end points only, so intra-year lows and highs are missing. Forward P/E cannot be computed from an attributed consensus (none found); on Q4 2026 guided revenue the engine, not this lane, projects EPS. sources nm_ib_hist, pf_10k_20260416, nm_rel_20261015.

nm PRICE vs OWN HISTORY the ADR rose from US$166 (Apr 2025 close) to US$408.79 (+146%) in 18 months while trailing EPS per ADR rose about 3.1x from the 2024 level; the multiple (26x trailing) is inside its 5-year range but the earnings base is at peak margins (gross 66.4%, operating 58.7%): that is the point of the guidance track below.

nm TRACK RECORD revenue (guidance_track rows hold US$ billions, metric revenue) ratio actual / guided midpoint 1.0050, 1.0441, 1.0216, 1.0284, 1.0199, 1.0152, 1.0336: mean about 1.024 over 7 periods, 7 beats, 0 misses; every quarter from Q1 2025 to Q3 2026 landed above the midpoint, and above the top of the range in Q2 2025 (30.07 vs 29.2), Q3 2025 (33.10 vs 33.0), Q4 2025 (33.73 vs 33.4), Q1 2026 (35.90 vs 35.8), Q2 2026 (40.20 vs 40.2, at the top) and Q3 2026 (46.72 vs 45.8). Q1 2025 was inside the range (25.53 vs 25.8 top). TSMC guides conservatively. Gross margin: actual above guided midpoint every period (by +0.4 to +3.0 points; mean about +1.5), also 7 of 7. Operating margin guidance (latest) 56.5-58.5% for Q4 2026 versus 58.7% delivered in Q3 against 56-58% guided. Guided exchange rate also matters: guidance is in US$ at an assumed NT$ rate (31.8 for Q4 2026 vs 32.0 for Q3), so NT$ revenue also moves with the rate.

nm GUIDANCE Q4 2026 (issued 2026-10-15, belongs to gather_documents for the guidance list): revenue US$52.3-54.3bn (mid 53.3, +14% q/q on Q3 46.72), gross margin 65-67%, operating margin 56.5-58.5%, at 31.8 NT$/US$. Applying the 7-period mean ratio would mean about US$54.6bn, a statistic not a forecast.

nm CONSENSUS NOT FOUND (attributed): one WebSearch (standard) and two page fetches (Benzinga 403, TickerLeague 404) gave no dated attributed annual table with n, low, high. Unattributed snippets seen in search results only, kept out of consensus rows: an aggregator stating Q4 2026 revenue consensus US$48.78bn before the Q3 report (guidance of 52.3-54.3 is above it); MarketBeat 2026-07-30 note quoting a consensus FY2026 EPS of $16.34 per ADR and Erste Group FY2026 $16.69 and FY2027 $21.25 per ADR (those are single-broker and pre-Q3, and trailing four-quarter EPS already stands at US$15.54, so they look stale); S&P Global Market Intelligence 2026-07-21 said FY2026 revenue forecasts rose 4.1% to US$171.6bn (consistent with H1 US$76.1bn + Q3 46.72 + Q4 guide 53.3 = US$176bn, so the Street was below the run rate). Target prices from those pages are opinions and are not recorded. Consensus rows are therefore empty: gap.

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch/forensic.json ROIC FY2024 52.9% (NOPAT 1,088.5bn / invested capital 2,148.5bn = equity + debt - cash only); it ignores NT$294bn of financial investments (FVOCI 192bn, amortized cost 102bn in current assets) and does not remove non-controlling interest (35bn); treating those as cash-like lifts FY2024 ROIC by about 5 points, so 53% is not overstated by this check. FY2025 is not in the prefetch series: from the 20-F, tax rate 17.0% (346.5/2,041.7), NOPAT = 1,936.1 x 0.83 = about NT$1,607bn, invested capital (total equity 5,396 + bonds payable non-current 856 + long-term loans 40 + leases 32 - cash 2,768, current portions of debt not read) about NT$3,556bn, ROIC about 45%; with financial investments of about NT$435bn also netted, about 51%. ROIC fell from 53% to about 45% because equity grew 27% on retained earnings and cash (a cash pile of NT$3.1tn at 2026-06-30), not because of weaker operating profit; incremental ROIC is the better read. Operating leases are inside the lease liabilities line.

nm CASH AND DEBT 2026-06-30 (6-K): cash and cash equivalents NT$3,134.2bn + FVOCI 193.2bn + amortized cost 190.4bn (current) = about NT$3.52tn of liquid assets; bonds payable non-current NT$815.0bn, long-term bank loans 49.2bn, lease liabilities 33.3bn (current portions and short-term loans not read). Net cash is positive by a wide margin. H1 2026 free cash flow before the large investment outflow: CFO 1,482.3bn - PP&E purchases 846.8bn = NT$635.6bn (FY2025: 2,275.0 - 1,272.4 = NT$1,002.6bn, 26% of revenue); government grants received for PP&E (NT$76bn in 2025) are reported in investing and not netted here. Dividends paid FY2025 NT$466.8bn; per-ADR dividend US$0.94 to 1.10 a quarter in 2026 (ex-dates Mar 17, Jun 11, Sep 16), paying a 0.8% yield on US$408.79.

nm CUSTOMERS AND LEVELS belong to gather_documents; one fact for the analyst from the 20-F: largest customer 25%, 22%, 19% of revenue in 2023, 2024, 2025 and second largest 11%, 12%, 17%; top ten customers about 70-78%. Mix of Q3 2026 wafer revenue: 2nm 8%, 3nm 33%, 5nm 28%, 7nm 10%, advanced (7nm and below) 79% (release 2026-10-15).

nm RESULTS DAY no source here is within 2 days of the as_of date (latest results 2026-10-15, 17 days earlier): all citable. Monthly revenue 6-Ks (e.g. 2026-10-08, September revenue; 2026-10-22 month-end) exist in identity.json filings but October 2026 revenue is not out until about 2026-11-10; not read by this lane.
